verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an email marketing SaaS that stores audience data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention settings, contact or data deletion API, or deletion workflow. Account export (mailchimp-docs-16) is data portability, an adjacent feature, and community reports of Mailchimp deleting accounts describe vendor action, not user control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
